as_of_content:
[[File:Unstable Energon Cube v2.png|right]]
==Description==
''A Crystal of pure, raw Energon that sometimes emits an unpredictable and sometimes deadly radiation. It may explode at any moment. Only accessible to those with experience dealing with Energon.''
==Relic Boosts==
*'''Tier 1:''' {1}% XP in Story and Special Missions
*'''Tier 2: '''5% XP in Story and Special Missions
*'''Tier 3:''' 10% XP in Story and Special Missions
*'''Tier 4:''' 15% XP in Story and Special Missions
==Obtainment==
The Tier 1 Cube was available in the Energon Booster Pack shortly after the game's global launch. Tiers 2-4 could be awarded by completely exploring the [[Shocking Revelation]] Special Missions.
